ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)

   D. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
